verdict.rationale: Crossplane's package model includes Providers that 'connect Crossplane to external APIs'. The docs give a concrete AWS RDS managed resource and pitch 'manage any resource anywhere' with a library of components. Community users corroborate cloud-agnostic resources backed by per-cloud controllers that stay portable across AWS, Azure and others. Missing for 10: an enumerated provider catalog showing coverage of GCP, Azure and other major clouds, any evidence of SaaS-provider coverage, and independent hands-on confirmation of ecosystem breadth.
